note: [L] proves ker trueP inside the monitor (the common kernel of all limiting one-slot functionals) and Bin.transfer equates the monitor with the null space of the smooth table. The vanishing of the remainder against every spectator (Upper.roots) is a hypothesis of Bin.quiet, whereas [M] derives it from Lemma E2.7 and F1b at this point; the cost_limit and marked_silent lemmas in D04 carry that derivation.

structure Upper (P : Bin S) (f : Order) (d : ℕ) : Prop where
  slides : Matrix P d f
  roots (i : Shot C.book) (x : C.label d) : Tendsto (fun u : ℕ×ℕ => snapshots i d u (x-(P d).step u x)) f.fuse (𝓝 0)
